auditoriums_coordinates.name: auditoriums_coordinates
auditoriums_coordinates.value: ("auditoriums"."latitude" IS NULL AND "auditoriums"."longitude" IS NULL) OR ("auditoriums"."latitude" BETWEEN 6 AND 37 AND "auditoriums"."longitude" BETWEEN 68 AND 98)

offline_bookings_amounts.name: offline_bookings_amounts
offline_bookings_amounts.value: ("offline_bookings"."amount_paise" IS NULL OR "offline_bookings"."amount_paise" >= 0) AND ("offline_bookings"."advance_paise" IS NULL OR "offline_bookings"."advance_paise" >= 0)

pricing_rules_range.name: pricing_rules_range
pricing_rules_range.value: "pricing_rules"."valid_from" IS NULL OR "pricing_rules"."valid_to" IS NULL OR "pricing_rules"."valid_from" <= "pricing_rules"."valid_to"

pricing_rules_kind_dates.name: pricing_rules_kind_dates
pricing_rules_kind_dates.value: ("pricing_rules"."kind" IN ('BASE', 'WEEKEND', 'MUHURTHAM')) OR ("pricing_rules"."valid_from" IS NOT NULL AND "pricing_rules"."valid_to" IS NOT NULL)

bookings_hold_has_expiry.name: bookings_hold_has_expiry
bookings_hold_has_expiry.value: "bookings"."status" NOT IN ('HELD', 'PENDING_PAYMENT') OR "bookings"."hold_expires_at" IS NOT NULL

generated.as: CASE slot WHEN 'MORNING' THEN int4range(0, 1) WHEN 'EVENING' THEN int4range(1, 2) ELSE int4range(0, 2) END

hall_occupancy_one_source.name: hall_occupancy_one_source
hall_occupancy_one_source.value: ("hall_occupancy"."booking_id" IS NOT NULL) <> ("hall_occupancy"."block_id" IS NOT NULL)
